SELECT TOP 10 CLI.CodCliente, CLI.Nome, CLI.CGCCPF, CLI.Fone1, CLI.Celular,
       O.Observações, O.FPgto, O.Emissão,
       GV.Placa AS VeiculoPlaca, GV.Modelo AS VeiculoModelo
FROM CLIENTES CLI
LEFT JOIN Orçamentos O ON O.Cliente = CLI.CodCliente
LEFT JOIN GRVeículos GV ON GV.Cliente = CLI.CodCliente AND GV.Placa = '{{ ($json.body.placa || "").toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/g,"") }}'
WHERE CLI.CGCCPF = '{{ $json.body.documento.replace(/\D/g,'').replace(/^(\d{3})(\d{3})(\d{3})(\d{2})$/, '$1.$2.$3-$4').replace(/^(\d{2})(\d{3})(\d{3})(\d{4})(\d{2})$/, '$1.$2.$3/$4-$5') }}'
ORDER BY O.Emissão DESC;
SELECT TOP 1 Modelo FROM GRVeículos WHERE Placa = '{{ $json.Placa.toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/g,"") }}'
SELECT TOP 1 Modelo FROM GRVeículos WHERE Placa = '{{ $json.Placa.toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/g,"") }}'
